title: [Bug] Memory Leak When Initializing Sub-Agent Orchestration
body:
**Bug Description**
If I continue this session by issuing an instruction like "Continue as an orchestrator, directing sub-agents to perform the necessary work." claude code will start allocating memory until all system memory is exhausted and the process crashes. In a newly-launched `claude` session, Activity Monitor shows that the claude process has about 450MB allocated (once I resume the session); when I issue the command, I can watch it start allocating massive amounts of memory almost right away, growing to 500, 1GB, 1.5GB, 2GB, 4GB, 4.5GB, 6GB,....30GB, ...crash

It doesn't *always* begin the massive allocations immediately. Sometimes, it'll run a prompt for a while, seeming normal, but within a prompt or two it will innevitably get into the massive allocation state and crash.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 1.0.100
- Feedback ID: 5e71aaf2-81fd-47bb-b0a9-8a15b230127c

**Errors**
